_source: Hand-worked in gap-template.xlsx (exported as gap-worked.pdf), line by line from the two Outcomes. Not derived from explainGap() or from AI output.
_conventions: D34: every line is positive when it helps Path A; flat value is A - B, every cost or amount owed is B - A; BSD and LEGAL count only their cash-paid part; CASH_PURCHASE is housing cash spent minus the five cash lines.
_inputs: Path A = evaluate.json case E2 (BTO Standard, HDB loan). Path B = case E1 (resale, HDB loan) with each buyer's cpfOaBalanceCents set to 1000000, so stamp duty is paid in cash. Both with assumptions.horizonYear = 2033. The Outcomes themselves are evaluate() output, used as inputs here.
